title: Stride/speed warping to eliminate foot-sliding (AUTH #043)
summary: Continuously warp the locomotion clip's stride and playback so foot-plant timing matches the actual ground speed on flats, slopes, accel/decel and turns, with foot-plant IK locking a planted foot within footPlantLockRadiusA so no contact slides. The C# matches the Brain-B reference services/traversal/locomotion_ref.stride_scale.
deliverables: unity (stride/speed warp on the locomotion set + foot-plant IK lock)
config/movement.json locomotion block (Operator lockstep with the C# MovementConfig migration, AUTH #043 bundled with #036)

acceptance_tests.test: Over 60 s of scripted variable-speed play on a corpus room, measured foot-slip stays within threshold at every speed, and the stride scale matches locomotion_ref.stride_scale for the current ground speed.
Locomotion reads with real-body weight and platformer responsiveness (Bible §0 bar) on the Owner's iPhone.
